assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE transparent sprite atlas for a 2.5D overhead fantasy exploration game. Create exactly 12 separate scenery props, meticulously arranged in a strict 4-column by 3-row grid of equally sized cells. Each object is fully isolated inside its own cell, centered horizontally, feet aligned near the bottom, generous transparent gutters of at least 10% of the cell on every side. No touching or spilling into neighboring cells. True transparent RGBA background; absolutely no text, labels, border, checkerboard, UI icons or backdrop. Painted fantasy RPG environment art: soft natural materials, clear substantial silhouettes, restrained detail, muted moss green, warm gray weathered stone, old oak timber, antique brass. Fixed north-up oblique overhead game view, looking down about 45 degrees, consistent upper-left daylight and small contact shadows. Real substantial landscape pieces, not collectible item icons. Row 1 left to right: 1) ivy-covered broken ancient stone arch with a short wall extending to the right, 2) crumbled cylindrical watchtower with a large split in its upper wall, 3) two surviving arches of a broken elevated Romanesque aqueduct, 4) long low moss-covered ruin wall with a collapsed doorway and scattered blocks. Row 2 left to right: 5) ruined stone windmill with two broken wooden sails, 6) old timber waterwheel attached to a fragment of mill wall, 7) cracked marble statue of a cloaked explorer on a plinth, face weathered away, 8) collapsed open-air library remains with carved pillars and fallen shelves. Row 3 left to right: 9) broken brass armillary sphere on a broad round stone pedestal, 10) abandoned round stone kiln with old clay vessels, 11) root-covered ancient dolmen entrance of three huge standing stones, 12) weathered carved obelisk snapped diagonally above a stepped square foundation. Every object must fill its own cell well without crossing the gutter. Elegant original hand-painted game scenery, no humans, no monsters. Landscape image, aspect ratio 4:3.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE transparent sprite atlas for a 2.5D overhead fantasy exploration game. Exactly 12 distinct landscape props in a strict 4-column by 3-row grid of equally sized cells. Each object isolated inside its own cell, centered, with its base at the bottom and generous 10% transparent gutters all around. No overlapping adjacent cells. True transparent RGBA background, no text, no labels, no UI, no border, no checkerboard, no rectangular ground patches. High quality hand-painted fantasy RPG scenery, fixed north-up oblique overhead view looking down about 45 degrees. Consistent upper-left daylight, restrained texture, natural soft highlights and small contact shadows. Broad readable substantial silhouettes suitable for a mobile game. Row 1 left to right: 1) slender white-barked birch grove of three trunks with airy light yellow-green leaves, 2) graceful hanging weeping willow with long teal-green fronds, 3) rugged windswept pine leaning to the right with layered dusty green needles, 4) tall dark slender cypress pair with a small lichen-covered stone at the roots. Row 2 left to right: 5) broad copper-leaf autumn tree with warm amber and rust foliage and a winding old trunk, 6) blackened dead tree with two fresh bright green shoots and pale gray ash at roots, 7) irregular rocky limestone ridge with three peaks and sparse mountain grass, 8) fractured warm sandstone escarpment with visible horizontal sediment layers and a small grassy ledge. Row 3 left to right: 9) jagged blue-gray alpine mountain outcrop with a few tufts of gold grass, 10) dark angular basalt crags with thin turquoise mineral veins, 11) limestone cave rock formation with hanging roots and a cluster of small soft amber mushrooms, 12) deep blue cave stalagmites with small muted moonstone crystals. Props only, no scene, no water pools, no characters. Each object uses at most 80% of its cell width and 80% of its height. Landscape image, aspect ratio 4:3.
